title: First Steps: Euler Spiral
description: Section 9.5 Euler spiral patch with normalized tau sweep, OP-TIME-aware phase centering, centered X/Y coordinate initial states, and X/Y scope output.

walkthrough.title: Generate the tau ramp
walkthrough.text: P1 scales -1 and feeds I1. In v081 the preset uses a normalized tau variable that sweeps from -1 to +1 across the selected OP-TIME; the runtime derives the visible phase span from that OP-TIME.

walkthrough.title: Build the quadrature oscillator
walkthrough.text: I2 and I3 hold the cos-like and -sin-like states. MUL1 forms tau*sin and MUL2 forms tau*cos, closing the variable-frequency loop. Their rates and initial states are auto-centered for the selected OP-TIME.

walkthrough.title: Integrate the x coordinate
walkthrough.text: P2 scales the cos-like signal. INV2 supplies the sign needed by the inverting I4 integrator, and I4.out is routed to OUT X. The serialized template gives I4 a centered initial state so the default sweep starts on the negative arm.

walkthrough.title: Integrate the y coordinate and use X/Y display
walkthrough.text: P5 scales I3.out, which is the -sin-like signal. The inverting I5 integrator recovers the positive y motion and sends it to OUT Y for x/y mode. I5 also has a centered initial state so the trace crosses the origin mid-run and shows both arms.
